about: Cited 40-yard dash times for players in the m2 team-seasons (WR, CB, S, RB, edge rushers) that the nflverse combine file lacks. The ratings model uses them after 2K's own retail speed and the nflverse combine time, in the order combine, pro_day, other, and maps every time onto 2K5's scale the same way as a combine 40 (speed = 315.1 - 50.7 x forty). An entry with forty null records that the search found no usable time; that player keeps the position profile, flagged speed_source 'profile' in the manifest.

kinds.combine: an NFL combine time the nflverse file lacks (for example before 2000)
kinds.other: a cited time whose event the source does not name
